name: pAIchart
description: AI-native service orchestration platform. Discover MCP services by capability, chain multi-service-workflows at runtime, and authenticate per-user via JWKS/External OAuth. A single pAIchart MCP server needs only 10 tools to access hundreds of registered local or network MCP servers solving the context issue individual MCP server tools impose. Enabled by pAIchart's service_call innovation.
